title: How to Migrate Your AI Memory from ChatGPT & Google to Claude
description: Switching AI assistants shouldn't mean starting from scratch. Learn how to export your personalized preferences, project contexts, and biographical memories from ChatGPT and import them into Anthropic Claude Projects.
pricingDetails: Free setup guide & memory prompt template

promptSet.title: Master Personal Context & Preference Dossier
promptSet.prompt: Review everything you know about my profession, communication style, tech stack, and goals. Synthesize this into a structured markdown document titled "System Context: User Profile" that I can import into another AI tool.
instructions: Run this extraction prompt in your existing AI assistant.
Copy the generated Markdown profile document.
Upload the file to Claude's Project Knowledge to retain full context.
promptSet.exampleOutput: A structured markdown document containing your full professional persona and coding style preferences.
